utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive! I thought it was next weekend. Can you remind me of the details?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to help out with fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the playground! That's a great idea. But wait, is it this weekend or next? I always get confused.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow? I'm bringing extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Almost — I've got the valve map ready, but I still need to double-check the supply closet for pipe wrenches before morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, glad you've got the valve map! I'll grab a couple of extra pipe wrenches from my garage just in case the closet's low.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I was just talking to Vik about the repair drive—he fixed a rusty chain in ten minutes flat, can you believe it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's great. I'll try to drop off something, but no guarantees.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey, even just showing up to see what Vik can do would be worth it—that guy's a wizard with tools!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Dane, you mean the Andersons' car? Yeah, we're all pitching in tools and parts this Saturday to get it running again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good, Saturday works for me. I can bring that set of socket wrenches I've got.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, those socket wrenches should really help—I think Mike said the alternator needs some work too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I'm glad I ran into you. Do you have any spare screwdrivers or wrenches we could borrow for the repair drive Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, no, it hasn't happened yet—it's this Saturday! We're collecting tools now to fix up broken stuff for the community.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Say, Gus, have you heard about that repair drive this weekend? I'm finally going to get my squeaky lawn mower looked at—Vik can fix anything!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great to hear, Tess! I've got a spare wrench if you need it—just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus! I might take you up on that—I just hope Vik's got some spare parts for my old mower, too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Sam, are you able to help with the water pump repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm organizing it this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I should be able to make it! I just need to confirm the school pickup time for Leo—can we plan for a quick handoff around 11?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, I do like a clear schedule—have we settled on who's bringing the wrenches and who's handling the soldering kits?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've got the wrenches covered, Eli, and I'm grabbing a spare fuse on my way—just making sure we're all set for the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, glad to hear that. So we're sticking with Saturday at 9 at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli! I think the repair drive's this Saturday... or was it Sunday? I just can't keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's Saturday, Oren. Starts at nine.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday! Nine o'clock—got it. I'll put a note on my fridge so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I was thinking, maybe my old fence could use some attention too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a fence? I hadn't even thought about that—maybe I should check my garden gate before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, maybe we can both bring our stuff to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there at 9 with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo! The more the merrier—I'll put you down for 9 AM and make sure everyone knows you're bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Rosa, you joining the repair drive too? I'm planning to be there by 10 with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Mina, I'm glad you're coming! Just a heads up — the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday? Well, that changes things. What happened to Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important with the repair drive plans?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane. We're set for this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I should be good for Saturday. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not directly fix, but I did see the tool inventory shift — that hydraulic jack we tracked? It's now in the Anderson's garage, exactly where Ira said it'd be needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The inventory shift could be coincidence. You actually watched the drive move the jack?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Jules, you joining the repair drive too, or are you just here to watch?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I'm definitely joining! Vik got me motivated—he's a wizard with tools, you know? I was thinking of bringing my old lawnmower to see if he can work his magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A lawnmower, huh? What's wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm glad to see you, Leo! Are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow? I've got extra tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got some screwdrivers Uli asked for, and a few wrenches. Ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo! Rosa will have the check-in table set up, so just head there first and we'll get everyone sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Pia, I heard the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Are you planning to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, but I'm still not sure about the exact drop-off time—did they say morning or afternoon? And do we have a checklist so nothing gets missed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think Cleo mentioned Saturday morning, but I don't have a checklist—maybe we can ask around for one?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the repair drive... I'll be there, just not sure what I can offer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm swamped but I'll dig through my garage for any spare parts this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I might have some old wiring I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Gus, have you actually seen the repair drive fix something yourself, or is this just what you've heard from others?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Hana, I saw it patch up a garden hose leak for Mrs. Chen yesterday. That thing's the real deal.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's good to know—you saw it with your own eyes on the hose. So it's not just talk then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'm glad we're on the same page. I'll be at the school pickup spot right after drop-off, so we can finalize the drive details then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Faye. I'll bring the supply list so we can go over what's still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Cleo. I'll grab the spare parts I've been collecting and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, Rosa, I also overheard they might have someone who can patch up small electronics! I'm thinking of bringing my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Tess! The repair drive is actually happening this Sunday at the community center now, so bring that lamp along — I'm sure someone can take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Sunday, perfect! I'll make sure to bring my lamp—and maybe that old fan too if it fits in the car.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all getting together to fix up the Andersons' car.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday! Right, that's what I thought. I keep mixing it up with Sunday. Count me in for the Andersons' car.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, glad you're on board! I'll let Vik know you're coming—he's been rounding up tools all week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey! The repair drive is still on for tomorrow—tools can be dropped off anytime between 9 and noon. Got any wrenches or screwdrivers to spare?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got a couple of screwdrivers I can bring by. Maybe you could take a look at my fence too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, Rey! I'd be happy to take a look at your fence tomorrow—just bring those screwdrivers with you when you drop them off.
